}}'''Duranda Tharne''' is the innkeeper of ''[[The Good Night's Ride]]'' in [[Lugard]], and an agent of the [[Blue Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Duranda Tharne}}

==Appearance==
She is a tall and heavy-set woman with hair dyed red.

==History==
She is one of the [[eyes-and-ears]] of the [[Blue Ajah]] and reports to [[Aeldene Stonebridge]].

==Activities==
When [[Siuan Sanche]] travels to Lugard, she seeks out Mistress Tharne to find out where the Blue Ajah has fled to after the [[White Tower Schism]]. After Duranda embarrasses Siuan, she gives her the code "Sallie Daera," pointing Siuan to [[Salidar]].{{ref/book|5|11}}
